items.name: CAU ao Cubo 2025

venue.name: Univali - Univerdade do Vale do Itajaí

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAzMzQyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--0d466bb391d289e8327553dfccbfc966067c67a2/WhatsApp%20Image%202025-06-19%20at%2021.03.48.jpeg)

Bem-vindos ao CAU ao cubo 2025, em Itajaí!

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba Inscrever. Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste vídeo.https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8

Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição.

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para novatos na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'.

A premiação extra-oficial será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida pela primeira rodada)

Inscrições no local serão aceitas apenas para o evento 3x3x3.

🇺🇸 Welcome to the CAU ao cubo 2025, competition in Itajaí!


Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. If you have any problem with how to register, take a look at this video.
https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8

Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition.

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event.

The unofficial awards will be given according to the competitor's position in the competition (It will not be based on the first round results.)

On-site registration will be accepted only for the 3x3x3 event.

Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€.
Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](#61258-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**.
Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAxMDczLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7bae8e24c0d80382dd9a38aafcb77a97eb8a4327/Screenshot%202025-06-10%20154933.png)

**Deutsch**
Liebe Speedcuber,

wir laden euch herzlich zur Dreiländereck Open am 25. und 26. Oktober 2025 ein! 
Das Turnier entsteht in Zusammenarbeit von Speedcubing-Communities aus Frankreich, Deutschland und der Schweiz.

Freut euch auf ein länderübergreifendes Event mit spannenden Solves und einer tollen Community.
Wir freuen uns auf euch!

**Français:**
Chers speedcubers,

Nous avons le plaisir de vous inviter à la Dreiländereck Open, les 25 et 26 octobre 2025 !
Le tournoi est organisé en collaboration entre les communautés de speedcubing de France, d'Allemagne et de Suisse.

Un bel événement transfrontalier vous attend, avec des solves passionnants et une superbe communauté.
Nous avons hâte de vous accueillir !

**English**
Dear Speedcubers,

We warmly invite you to the Dreiländereck Open on October 25–26, 2025!
This competition is a collaboration between speedcubing communities from France, Germany, and Switzerland.

Look forward to an international event with exciting solves and a fantastic community.
We’re excited to see you there!

items.name: Cuboss Open 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAxNjk2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--21e72b3a5efeeda6237474706863e347bd165b70/cuboss-open-2025-logo-cropped.png)

Varmt välkomna till Cuboss Open 2025! Detta blir en väldigt speciell tävling, där WCA-grenarna blandas med en mängd olika specialgrenar. Dessutom kommer det ske väldigt mycket roliga grejer i lokalen. 

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet.

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

--

Welcome to Cuboss Open 2025! This will be a very special competition, where the WCA events are mixed with a variety of special events. In addition, there will be a lot of other fun happenings at the venue. 

Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

[![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDgyNDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d739808be3a2373fd1129978150c3798d3405ee0/IMG_1309.png)
### Speedcubing returns to the Big Island with another WCA competition, our first time in the fall!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:30 AM.
